retrievalProfile.description: A vibrant 1980s pop aesthetic featuring a large central portrait flanked by smaller circular inset portraits, defined by bold primary-colored geometric frames and halftone textures.
triggerTerms: halftone grid background with primary color accents

recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered composition combining high-contrast studio photography with bold, flat geometric shapes. The layout uses a large rectangular focal image on the right and a vertical stack of three circular portraits on the left, all unified by a dark blue background with a subtle cyan halftone grid.
coreVisualRelationships: Large focal portrait balanced by a vertical column of circular insets
Primary color borders (red, yellow, green, blue) framing individual elements
Overlapping geometric shapes creating a sense of depth and movement
High-contrast studio lighting with saturated makeup and fashion
coreInvariants: Thick, vibrant geometric borders around all photographic elements
A dark blue background featuring a repeating cyan halftone or grid pattern
Vertical alignment of circular sub-portraits on the left third of the frame

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame at large scale; three secondary subjects are contained in circles on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large central portrait's eyes and the bold red display text at the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top right text, moves down the main portrait, then sweeps left to the vertical stack of circular images.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with shapes, text, and patterns.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright Red and Yellow (borders and display text)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Green and Pink (secondary borders and fashion accents)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all hues against a dark, low-value background.

letterConstructionRules: Display text uses extreme stroke contrast with thin horizontals and thick verticals
Secondary text uses a clean, bold, all-caps geometric sans-serif
Numerical elements are stylized with thick outlines and drop shadows
characterSpecificRedesigns: Enlarged initial or terminal characters in the main title for emphasis
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for branding paired with a neutral, heavy sans-serif for clarity.

preserve: High contrast between thick and thin strokes in display text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the extreme contrast and vertical stress of the display text.
Matches the geometric, uniform weight of the subtitle text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a dark blue background with a cyan halftone grid. Place a large rectangular portrait on the right and three vertically stacked circular portraits on the left. Add thick red, yellow, and green borders to the circles.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a high-contrast serif title in red and pink at the top right. Place a bold white sans-serif subtitle directly beneath it. Add stylized numbers in the bottom left corner with thick outlines.

verificationChecks: Is the halftone pattern visible in the background?
Are the circular portraits vertically aligned on the left?
Does the display text have extreme stroke contrast?
Are the primary colors (red, yellow, blue) dominant in the graphics?

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subjects
postGenerationChecks: Check that the red display text is the largest typographic element.
Ensure the halftone grid does not obscure the portraits.
Verify that the circular frames use distinct primary colors.
Confirm the composition feels balanced despite the asymmetrical layout.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine high-fashion studio photography with 80s Memphis-inspired geometric overlays and high-contrast serif typography.
